column_description: Unique identifier for each position record.
Reference to the drone that the position data belongs to. may be NULL.
X coordinate of the drone's position. may be NULL.
Y coordinate of the drone's position. may be NULL.

Timestamp of when the position was recorded. may be NULL.
Altitude of the drone. may be NULL.
Latitude of the drone. may be NULL.
Longitude of the drone. may be NULL.
Accuracy of the position data. may be NULL.
